rules: Central policy may conflict with House interests.
Current Chancellor/leadership is temporal World State.
Council participation/standing requires actual political state.
House influence does not equal automatic command over every Imperial unit.

organizations.instance_model: Each persistent House is its own organization/social-political network.
rules: House membership is persistent kinship/social state.
Different Houses may pursue competing interests.
A House is not identical to the Empire or military.
House status and military rank remain separate.
Local commanders can act within or against wider political pressure only through represented events.

ai_guardrails: Do not invent House membership or Council seat.
Do not infer military service from Klingon species.
Do not let House reputation silently grant Imperial command authority.
